verdict.pick: Transparent Labs Grass‑Fed Whey Protein Isolate
verdict.line: Picture a busy athlete who needs a clean, high‑protein shake after training. Transparent Labs Grass‑Fed Whey Protein Isolate delivers 24 g of pure whey protein per scoop, is free from artificial sweeteners and has a smooth, creamy texture that mixes well. It stands out because it is the only product in this guide that is certified grass‑fed and has no added sugar, giving it a cleaner profile than the other picks.
